news.headline: The drugmaker Abivax has still not been acquired. What's going on?
news.summary: Despite red-hot biotech M&A activity and months of AstraZeneca/Eli Lilly takeover speculation, Abivax remains independent; STAT examines why a deal keeps stalling, citing the cancer-signal complication from trial data and the company's $920M raise giving it a credible solo path.

news.headline: 3 takeover targets in immunology
news.summary: PharmaVoice names Abivax alongside Spyre and MoonLake as a top immunology M&A target, noting its recent Phase 3 ABTECT maintenance Part 2 exploratory results and additional trial data expected in 2027.

news.headline: Abivax Announces Positive Pre-NDA Interaction with the FDA for Obefazimod
news.summary: The FDA gave constructive feedback aligning with Abivax's planned NDA submission strategy and content/format for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis; the company remains on track to submit its first NDA by the end of 2026.

news.headline: Abivax Strengthens Commercial Capabilities With Strategic Leadership Appointments
news.summary: Abivax named four new commercial leaders spanning marketing, patient services, sales and market access, including a Global Head of Marketing from Amgen/Takeda, as it builds out its team ahead of a planned Q4 2026 NDA filing and potential US launch.

news.headline: Abivax re-engages Centerview Partners amid renewed takeover interest
news.summary: Reports indicated Abivax re-engaged banker Centerview Partners as takeover interest resurfaced, even as the company simultaneously builds independent US commercialization capacity.

news.headline: Abivax's $920 million cash haul lets it prepare for solo U.S. launch instead of relying on a buyer, CEO tells CNBC
news.summary: CEO Marc de Garidel told CNBC the company's $920M ADS offering, which funds operations through 2029, gives Abivax the option to commercialize obefazimod independently in the US rather than needing to sell to a large pharma.

catalysts.label: Euronext CAC Steering Committee quarterly index review
catalysts.detail: Euronext's next CAC Steering Committee review is scheduled for Thursday, September 10, 2026; markets are watching whether Abivax is promoted further (it joined CAC Mid 60/SBF 120 in the September 2025 annual review) given its market-cap surge.

catalysts.label: H1 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Abivax's official IR financial calendar lists H1 2026 results for September 21, 2026, likely to include a pipeline/regulatory update and possible NDA-timeline commentary.

catalysts.label: Full ABTECT maintenance data presentation
catalysts.detail: Company has guided to presenting full Phase 3 ABTECT maintenance data (following the Part 2 exploratory readout) at a major GI congress in Q4 2026.

catalysts.label: US NDA submission for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis
catalysts.detail: Following the positive pre-NDA FDA interaction, Abivax reiterates it is on track to submit its first NDA for obefazimod by the end of 2026.

catalysts.label: EMA Marketing Authorization Application (MAA) submission
catalysts.detail: Company guidance targets submission of the EU MAA for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis in this window.

catalysts.label: ENHANCE-CD Phase 2b Crohn's disease topline data
catalysts.detail: Topline 12-week induction results from the Phase 2b ENHANCE-CD trial of obefazimod in moderately-to-severely active Crohn's disease are expected mid-2027.

catalysts.label: Potential FDA approval and US launch
catalysts.detail: Assuming on-time NDA submission and standard review, potential FDA approval and commercial launch of obefazimod in ulcerative colitis is targeted for H2 2027.

pulse: Abivax remains one of biotech's most-watched unconsummated M&A stories: AstraZeneca and Eli Lilly takeover speculation persists (STAT, PharmaVoice) even as the company builds independent US commercial infrastructure off its $920M July raise and a positive late-July pre-NDA FDA interaction. Two catalysts loom before month-end: Euronext's September 10 CAC index review (possible further index promotion) and the September 21 H1 2026 results, which investors will watch for fresh NDA-timeline and any deal-related commentary ahead of the planned Q4 2026 NDA filing.
